findings.text: At 57 m and beyond, a land-use boundary is a LATTICE STAIRCASE: _band_weights() is a function of u alone, so every band edge is a dead-straight line for 2,588 m, quantised to 3.90 m cells and read per-triangle. It is the most indexable thing in the 57 m frame. NOT FIXED: the cure is a wander term inside sample(), which changes GROUND_DIGEST, the 1,400-entry PATCH_LOD_ERR_MM table and what drum_walk builds collision from, and was judged too large a blast radius for one session against a defect the brief did not name.

findings.text: Past the near rung's 90 m reach a parcel is a flat wash of one colour with a tiling texture. Rows are a MATERIAL problem at that distance, not a geometry one -- the field's finest representable octave is 13.5 m and 34b's rows are finer -- and materials are not this agent's files. Frames shot at 184 m and 369 m came back BYTE-IDENTICAL before and after (md5 38f19b47f521ca9999e8707976527e9b and c1a6303dfd190ee08f4359dfd8a456d7), which is the honest measure of this gap.

The refinement quarters the facet size near the eye but the ground still reaches the engine with no vertex normals, so it is still flat shaded. Smooth normals would do more for the near field than any further subdivision, and they are an export_scene change.

113,790 of 120,000 is 94.8% of the module's own allowance. P4 wants worst case at 70% or under. The allowance itself is a slice of budget.DRUM and is defended in INV-458; nothing here is over, but there is no headroom to spend on the far field.
